observations: Torah LM2 #65 is one of the briefest teachings in Likutay Moharan — four sentences establishing a single equivalence: zealotry for God (קנאת ה' צבאות) is considered like tzedakah (צדקה). The entire teaching rests on this one bechina statement, supported by the Tosafot's interpretation of Nevuzaradan's act. There are no additional concepts introduced with bechina language, no secondary domains developed, and no structural complexity that would warrant a second package. The dataset's single edge fully captures the Torah's conceptual content. No new package is warranted.
